messages:
remy: dropped an updated A/B diff panel — main asks: make the heatmap readable at a glance, clarify the small 'A/B' pill, and ensure the rollback affordance isn't confusing with Rewind. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/new-ab-heatmap (frame 5).

kayla: quick glance: heatmap colors look nice but low contrast between muted and medium cells. suggest swapping the middle token for a slightly darker hue or adding a 1px border to separate cells. also consider a zebra row for alternating versions.

ben: microcopy: the tiny pill currently says 'A/B 70/30' which reads fast but is ambiguous for SR users. propose visible text 'Split 70/30' and aria-label 'A/B split: A 70 percent, B 30 percent'. keep visual density but add aria-label.

sofia: accessibility: when toggling between AB pairs the focus should remain on the active pair. add aria-pressed on toggle and ensure keyboard nav cycles within the AB pair controls. also heatmap cells need title attributes for tooltip fallback.

ops-bot: automated lint:
- Contrast issue flagged on heatmap mid-tone (ratio 3.1:1).
- Small pill missing aria-label (5 occurrences).
- Heatmap cells missing alt/title (12 occurrences).

remy: action items:
- design: test darker mid-tone or 1px separator + zebra option (remy + kayla)
- eng: add aria-label to AB pill, aria-pressed on toggles, title attrs for cells (ben + sofia)
- writing: short pill copy variants: 'Split 70/30', 'A 70% • B 30%', '70/30 (A/B)' (ben)

kayla: also note: when a user hovers a row we currently highlight the whole row including the tiny rollback icon which makes it easy to misclick. separate the hover area from the action area and add a confirmation tooltip for rollback.

ben: agree — rollback should never be single-click. show a confirm modal and keyboard users should land on Cancel first. add a short rationale line: 'Reverts traffic and model changes.'

sofia: i'll draft the aria snippets and quick VO test steps. will post results once I run through the updated mock.

remy: thanks! aim to have new mocks by Mon midday. will ping when uploaded. :white_check_mark:
